name: @sandra/registry
description: BMH-specific shadcn registry items — Warm Paper / Organic Utility component variants for Sandra CRM, Sandra University, and Sandra Practice.

items.name: status-chip
items.title: Status Chip
items.description: 6-hue semantic status pill. Replying / Hot / New / Contacted / Cold / Dead. Fully pill, text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter. Used for lead status, score buckets, lesson states.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.description: Bento-grid stat card with icon halo, big number, optional delta badge, and description. Tone enum (healthy / warning / caution / info / critical) drives color via the alert palette tokens.

items.name: brand-lockup
items.title: Brand Lockup
items.description: Sidebar brand lockup — square mark + two-line product name + label-caps sub-label. Designed to drop inside a shadcn SidebarMenuButton size='lg' so it auto-collapses to icon-only.

items.name: search-input-pill
items.title: Search Input (pill)
items.description: Pill-shaped search input with a magnifying-glass icon. Stone-50 fill, no border, focus ring uses the foreground/ring token. Distinct from the standard rectangular Input — used for filter bars and command-style search.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Overlapping circular avatars with +N overflow chip. Supports image avatars and initials fallbacks. Two sizes (sm/md). Used in toolbars and filter strips.

items.name: fab
items.title: Floating Action Button
items.description: Bottom-right floating action button. The single documented exception to the no-shadow rule (shadow-2xl is intentional for visual lift). Required aria-label enforced by the type.

items.name: circular-pagination
items.title: Circular Pagination
items.description: Page-number strip with chevrons and circular buttons. Includes ellipsis logic for long ranges (skipped when totalPages ≤ 5). Renders as a semantic <nav> with proper aria-current on the active page.

items.name: inverted-highlight-card
items.title: Inverted Highlight Card
items.description: Dark-bg metric card for spotlight stats (Pipeline Value, headline KPIs). Inverted color scheme with optional decorative blur orbs and an inline white-on-dark CTA. Used to differentiate one tile in a bento grid.

items.name: sidebar-nav
items.title: Sidebar Nav
items.description: BMH primary-nav rail. Active items use a 4px solid left-border (no fill, no pill) — the Warm Paper hairline-accent pattern. Exports `<SidebarNav>` (nav landmark wrapper), `<SidebarNavItem>` (styled anchor row), and `sidebarNavItemClassName()` for composing with framework `<Link>` components without nesting anchors.

items.name: data-table-shell
items.title: Data Table Shell
items.description: Rounded-2xl bordered container + tinted footer strip that frame a shadcn `<Table>` as a card. Exports `<DataTableShell>` (outer chrome with overflow clip for shared rounded corners) and `<DataTableFooter>` (justify-between strip for `Showing X of Y` + pagination). Layout primitives only — does not re-implement Table headers/cells, since the deployed shadcn Table already carries BMH label-caps + generous padding.
